Yiwet n tebdart n tigawin, d wanda i d-tettban yal yiwet

Tigawin meṛṛa llant deg yiwet n tebdart, ula d tid i ternuḍ s yiman-ik. Fren anda i d-tettban yal yiwet: ɣef yiccaren yessersen, iccaren ur nesrusi ara d ikuramen, deg ufeggag n yiccaren yettwafernen, deg Umuɣ Ugar akked deg ufeggag n tigawin ddaw isebtar.
